newsitem.title: USA: Alco board okays Unisource spin off.
newsitem.headline: Alco board okays Unisource spin off.

text.p: Alco Standard Corp said its board declared a special dividend of 100 percent of the common stock of Unisource Worldwide Inc to Alco shareholders.
The action would create a new, independent public company.
Alco shareholders are to receive one share of Unisource common for for every two shares of Alco.
The distribution date will be December 31, record December 13.
Unisource is the largest marketer and distributor of paper products and supply systems in North America with fiscal 1996 revenues of $7 billion.
Alco also operates IKON Office Solutions, an office technology solutions company with annual revenues exceeding $4 billion.
Alco had announced earlier this year its intention to separate its two businesses.
Alco said its shareholders need not take any action in order to receive the Unisource shares.
Unisource will start trading under its own symbol January 2.
